items.title: [EXAMPLE] A lab releases an open evaluation harness for agent prompt-injection robustness
items.what_happened: A (fictional) research lab released an open-source harness with 300 prompt-injection scenarios for tool-using agents.
items.why_it_matters: Shared, adaptive benchmarks make agent-security claims comparable. static benchmarks overstate defenses.
items.what_to_watch: Whether results hold under adaptive attackers, and whether other labs report on it.
